name: harman_beta_2024_bk5128
source: Sean Olive, CanJam NYC 2024 pilot, as reported by SoundGuys: https://www.soundguys.com/harman-research-targets-the-bruel-kjaer-5128-112247/
note: Recipe only. The published B&K 5128 diffuse-field response is measurement data and is NOT embedded here; put your own 5128 DF curve in bk5128_df.csv beside this file (columns: frequency_hz,gain_db). The +6.4 dB shelf below 105 Hz and -1.4 dB shelf above 2.5 kHz are the constants reported for Harman Beta 2024; their realization as TargetParams' 105 Hz and 2.5 kHz basis functions is this project's implementation, not the published curve.
